title: Ring Charge Resource + Recharge Station Mechanic
description: Provides a ring_energy resource system and a proximity-activated recharge ritual at the Recharge Station pedestal. Features: ring_energy pool with configurable max and regen=0 by default; cost + per-second drain APIs for other mechanics (constructs, flight). When the player places the ring hand into the pedestal socket volume, begin a short recharge sequence: escalating haptics, rising green beam, UI fill on ring HUD, and playback of original (non-copyright) recharge line from the ring voice pack. On completion, set ring_energy to 100%. Prevents recharge when already full and enforces a brief cooldown on abort. Includes diegetic prompts via ring HUD and events for audio/VFX. Exposes JSON config: max_energy, low_energy_threshold, costs/drain overrides by construct type, recharge_duration_s, haptic_curve, pedestal_tag (entity tag for placement), ui_bindings (bar entity ids), and per-session willpower_stability curve that slightly extends sustained durations over time.
acceptance_notes:
- With ring_energy below 50%, placing the ring into the pedestal socket begins recharge with escalating haptics, beam VFX, and HUD fill; completes to 100%.
- API available to ring_construct_core and promoted.ring_hover_flight for cost/drain checks.
- No copyrighted oath text; uses original line from ring voice pack.
